verdict.rationale: Viam documents official SDKs in Python, Go, C++, TypeScript and Flutter. Its machine, fleet and ML training APIs are reachable from those SDKs, and the SDKs handle WebRTC/gRPC transport, sessions and automatic reconnects. Its agent guide states that an AI agent with an SDK can operate a machine, and the RDK GitHub repo and a community comment both confirm the SDKs exist. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or completeness across languages.
